note: Frozen nine-field target record per SHARED_CONTRACT_PARALLEL_20261029.md sec. 7. No extra fields are permitted on the record itself; per-dwell diagnostics (spectrum, tuning time, effective backend) live in a separate scan log.

target_id.semantics: stable monotonic counter assigned at first discovery; never reused within a run

center_hz.semantics: power-weighted centroid of the occupied span, rounded to integer Hz

bw_hz.semantics: occupied bandwidth span (bins within 20 dB of peak times bin_hz); 0 = unknown

power_valid.semantics: numeric power measurement, NOT a bare boolean flag: peak PSD power of the detected occupied span expressed in dB above the dwell's adaptive median noise floor (relative scale)
power_valid.source: detection PSD peak power minus the dwell's adaptive median noise floor (prominence of the selected peak)
power_valid.unit: dB above adaptive median noise floor (relative scale; NOT dBm, NOT dBFS)
power_valid.valid_means: value >= 14 dB means a valid detection (detector only reports peaks >= median + 14 dB); NaN or absent means unmeasured/invalid
power_valid.no_dbm: no absolute metrological contract exists offline, so dBm must never be reported from this field

top3.semantics: top-3 class labels with confidence, from the frozen NPU; empty until classified

last_seen.semantics: wall-clock time of the last re-detection, same epoch as receiver time.time()

status.semantics: new=first observation this cycle; tracking=re-detected; missing=missed in the latest revisit cycle but within the aging budget; expired=aged out (retained only in the audit log)

backend.semantics: selected backend mode for the last update (auto = FPGA with software fallback, per contract sec. 1)

classification_red_line: classification never reads test ground truth, transmit samples, or per-sample compensation; it is the frozen two-DC + NPU path
